Pure argument-inspection predicate — no I/O, no state, no branch imports by design. Runs on every command invocation, so log_operation() here would write a line per CLI call and drown the operation log.

Pure argument-inspection predicate -- no I/O, no state, no branch imports by design, the --json sibling of help_flags.py above. Runs on every command invocation, so log_operation() here would write a line per CLI call and drown the operation log.

Bare `todo` IS the verb, by ruling (DPLAN-0345 @memory review section 4, FPLAN-0590 row 5): `drone @memory todo` prints ONE line - pad N of COUNT and the backlog count - so handle_command() deliberately has no no-args gate calling print_introspection(); a gate there would replace that line with the module page. The module still defines print_introspection() (printed after a refused argument) and print_help() (--help/-h/help in any slot). The bare behaviour is pinned by tests/test_config_verbs_todo.py::TestTodoVerbs::test_bare_is_one_line_the_pad_of_the_configured_count_and_the_backlog. Same class as @ai_mail's apps/modules/email.py introspection rule (inbox works without args). Added 2026-09-15; DELETE this rule if bare `todo` ever becomes the introspection page.

File-wide because the checker names no line. An empty package marker: it tests no module, so it has no subject line or declared pass to state, and a header on an empty file would be the only content. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

File-wide because the checker names no line. Not a test file: the shared definition of the dead-cwd world that the subprocess pins import (it collects no tests). Its long docstring is why the world exists, and items 6 and 7 of the test template describe a file that tests a module. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

File-wide because stdlib_patch passes no line (the checklist calls a lines rule inert); it covers one patch, rr.os.scandir at 450. The only way to make a real directory unlistable for one call without root or platform ACLs. A scandir parameter on exists_exactly would be a door for the test alone (no caller passes it), so the patch stays: monkeypatch scopes it to this test and restores it, and the test asserts the denied listing was the parent. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @devpulse's landing ruling; made file-wide in leg 10.

File-wide because stdlib_patch passes no line; it covers two opt-in fixtures, case_insensitive_filesystem (Path.glob, 208) and case_insensitive_exists (Path.exists, 228). They emulate a case-insensitive filesystem so the case-fold pins go red on a case-sensitive disk. Every walk must see the emulation the way it sees the platform, so a product seam per walk would be a door for the tests alone, and Linux cannot show the effect on disk. monkeypatch restores both after each test that asks for them. Leg 10 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

The import is what is under test: the parked symbolic package (the owner's ruling of 2026-08-14) must refuse every import, the package and each submodule, naming the ruling. A top-of-file import would raise at collection and pin nothing. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

The test is about the import itself: it proves conftest's mock still shadows json_handler through `from X import y` at call time. A top-of-file import would bind before the autouse fixture runs and test nothing. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

The subject is import time: memory_files is evicted and imported fresh to prove a removed attribute is not re-created by a fresh import. A top-of-file binding is the already-imported module and could not see that. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

_reclaim_stale_lock answers 'is the lane free now'. False after a failed unlink means the lane is NOT free, which is true; the caller's decision (do not run) is the same as for a live lock, and the failure is logged at error. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

_check_vector_deps answers 'are chromadb and numpy confirmed importable'. A check that could not run has not confirmed them, so False is the true answer; the self-report reads it as degraded either way. Logged at warning. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

declared_roots: an unreadable AIPASS_ROOTS.json answers [] (no external roots), logged at error. Never None: ai_mail registry/read.py 474 and drone registry_handler.py 458 loop over the answer outside their try. Not a raise: detector.py 298 (read_scope, feeding health and lint) calls it bare. No caller writes [] out as truth. Rollover's write scope (detector.write_scope), the push, the todo lane and the normalizer all exclude the external tier. read_scope only reports, and an external name then answers 'Unknown branch', never another branch. Leg 12 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

Both lines are FileNotFoundError: an absent passport declares nothing (None), and an absent declared-roots file declares no roots ([]). That is the answer for an absent file, not a failure value; the unreadable roots branch (470) is not covered here. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision; lines moved in leg 10.

declared_residency: an unreadable passport declares nothing, logged at error. None cannot add or swap a citizen: a core citizen is kept (the sealed registry is the anchor) and a resident candidate is refused, the same policy as for an absent passport. The contract was asked for by @daemon (5031a591), whose scheduler calls it. Leg 10 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

_write answers 'written'. False on every path that did not write (fence refusal, failed write); the success path returns True only. The checker reads the fence refusal as success. Logged at error. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

_write_json answers 'written'. False on every path that did not write (fence refusal, failed write); the success path returns True only. The checker reads the fence refusal as success. Logged at warning. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

_read_ledger merges absent and unreadable on purpose: bump_pending counts both as PENDING ('a missing record of a push is not a record of a push') and its reason names both ('never pushed, or lost'). The unreadable case is logged at error. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

_resolve_branch and _validate_count return None only after _refuse(ctx, ...) has recorded the refusal and its reason; every None is a refusal and no success returns None. The checker reads the other refusals as success. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

handle_command answers 'was this command routed here', not 'did it succeed'. An invalid --n is handled: the error is printed to the user and logged, so True is correct and False would send the router looking for another handler. Leg 8 of DPLAN-0354, @memory's decision.

The stub is the cure (compass 493; @devpulse's leg 11 ruling (a)). Each keeps a far side off the disk or the bus. 88-91 aipass.prax: the real logger writes every module's log file under logs/, and its json service writes operation logs. 115-116 handlers.json.json_handler: log_operation writes memory_json operation logs. 123-126 aipass.trigger: Trigger.fire posts real events to the bus. Leg 11 of DPLAN-0354; lines moved +1 by the four-rows split (2026-10-08), which added the support_config_verbs import; moved -6 when the three unrequested fixtures and their imports were cut (2026-10-10).

The stub is the cure (ruling (a)). _get_module re-imports config_loader after the fixture evicted the json package, so it binds conftest's json_handler stand-in; with the real one bound, load/save write memory_json operation logs. Leg 11 of DPLAN-0354.

File-wide by devpulse's leg 12 ruling: each harness (_import_orchestrator, _import_extractor, _import_rollover_module, _import_normalize, _import_line_counter) stands fake handler modules in through monkeypatch.setitem and evicts through monkeypatch, so teardown removes every one. The fakes keep the run off live state: execute_rollover writes .trinity, the backups and the stores; the json package's json_handler writes operation logs; the detector walks the live fleet. The in-function imports bind under conftest's per-test prax/json/trigger stand-ins; at the top of the file they would bind the real logger at collection. The importlib fetches (161/162, 269, 1892, 1919, 2363, 2408, 3237) take the REAL module from the cache for the same reason and patch it at the edge. A lines rule closes a line here (measured on 86, leg 12); file-wide is the ruling. Leg 12 of DPLAN-0354.

File-wide by devpulse's leg 12 ruling, carried with the code: _import_extractor moved verbatim from tests/test_rollover_pipeline.py by the four-rows split (2026-10-08). It stands the json package and its handlers in through monkeypatch.setitem and evicts the extractor through monkeypatch, so teardown removes every one; the fakes keep extract_items off the live .trinity files and the operation logs. The import is in-function so it binds under the stand-ins, not the real logger at collection. Leg 12 of DPLAN-0354.

File-wide by devpulse's leg 12 ruling, carried with the code: _import_orchestrator moved verbatim from tests/test_rollover_pipeline.py by the four-rows split (2026-10-08). It stands the json, monitor and tracking handlers in through monkeypatch.setitem and evicts through monkeypatch, so teardown removes every one; the detector would otherwise walk the live fleet and the json shim write operation logs. The import is in-function so it binds under the stand-ins. Leg 12 of DPLAN-0354.

File-wide by devpulse's leg 12 ruling, carried with the code: the todo lane moved verbatim from tests/test_rollover_pipeline.py by the four-rows split (2026-10-08). The importlib fetches (_todo_roll, _point_todos_count, the tab renderer) take the REAL module from the cache inside the test, after conftest's per-test stand-ins are in, and patch it at the edge; at the top of the file they would bind the real logger at collection. Leg 12 of DPLAN-0354.

File-wide by devpulse's leg 12 ruling: the fixture (_real_verbs) evicts conftest's json package stand-in through monkeypatch (_evict records each one) and re-imports the REAL config_loader, detector, rollover and rollover_config (134, 149, 162, 171) so the code under test is real; teardown puts the stand-ins back. A top-of-file import would bind the real json shim and logger at collection, and those write operation logs. Leg 12 of DPLAN-0354; moved here from tests/test_config_verbs.py with the fixture by the four-rows split (2026-10-08).

File-wide by devpulse's leg 12 ruling: the fetches take real modules (todo_roll, todo_report, the json holders memory_files and entry_limits, the todo module, memory) from the cache under conftest's per-test prax/json stand-ins and patch them at the edge; a top-of-file import would bind the real json shim and logger at collection, and those write operation logs. Leg 12 of DPLAN-0354; copied here from tests/test_config_verbs.py with the todo classes by the four-rows split (2026-10-08).

File-wide by devpulse's leg 12 ruling, kept on the original for what stayed in it: the display tests fetch the real config_content and rollover_config modules from the cache under conftest's per-test prax/json stand-ins; a top-of-file import would bind the real json shim and logger at collection, and those write operation logs. The fixture's re-imports moved to tests/support_config_verbs.py and the todo fetches to tests/test_config_verbs_todo.py, each with its own copy of this row, by the four-rows split (2026-10-08). Leg 12 of DPLAN-0354.

Not stubs: each importlib.import_module fetches the REAL module. 54/55 first-import rollover_config and rollover_json before any stand-in lands, because what they bind at import they keep. 107-109 take the real cli flag helpers so the routing guards are real. 203/291 fetch the parent package to evict its cached attribute (monkeypatch restores it). 267/316 fetch the real handlers.cli package to compare with. Leg 11 of DPLAN-0354.

The stub is the cure (ruling (a)). rollover.py imports these at import time, and each far side writes. orchestrator.execute_rollover writes .trinity, the backups and the vector stores. memory_watcher.check_and_rollover runs that same rollover. detector's walk recreates a missing .trinity file. todo_report.roll_pad writes the .backup todo backlogs. plans_processor.process_plans embeds and writes the flow_plans store. 134-137 register the REAL cli flag helpers under the stand-in package, which has no __path__. 139/140 are the parent packages. 199 is the eviction of the cached rollover (del under the module constant _ROLLOVER_MODULE, after setitem so teardown restores it) that the re-import at 207 needs; the checker read the constant key from sentry leg 17 on, and devpulse added the line on 2026-10-05 as part of this same ruling. 207 is the deliberate re-import of rollover against them. Leg 11 of DPLAN-0354.

Ruling (b): tp._RULES_CACHE.clear() empties the module's cache of the global rules file so the test reads its own tmp copy and can count re-reads; there is no public reset, and no door is added for the test. Leg 11 of DPLAN-0354.

Contracts pinned on a tmp file: the meta line is tab then template semantics, a refresh restores _usage from the template and never leaves a bare tab, and the receipt is bumped after a refresh (or the refresh succeeds with no receipt). The public caller refreshes every live branch's .trinity files, which is live state. Leg 11 of DPLAN-0354.

File-wide because no_product_call passes no line (the checklist calls a lines rule inert); it covers TestWhatTheHostCanActuallyHold, lines 455 and 468. Host probes @devpulse asked for. They measure what the running file system holds (case-only names fold or not; a differing stem is always a second file), the premise every case-glob pin in this file is written on. No product code answers that question. Leg 11 of DPLAN-0354.
Its two operations are logged by storage/lane.run_json, the one subprocess runner, as subprocess_lane rows labelled vectorize_and_store and get_by_ids.
